title: Customer Service Officer
summary:
Recruit Masters is proudly partnering with a Queensland-owned company specialising in water purification systems. We’re on the hunt for a confident and organised Customer Service Officer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys variety in their day. 

About the Role 
You’ll be the heartbeat of the office — managing customer enquiries, coordinating technician runs, 
processing sales, and keeping operations on track. This is a hands-on role perfect for someone who loves working with people and isn’t afraid to jump in where needed. 

What You’ll Be Doing 
• Be the first point of contact for customers — in person, over the phone, and by email. 
• Manage orders, bookings, and customer quotes. 
• Process payments and sales transactions. 
• Prepare technician schedules and liaise with couriers. 
• Support stock control and warehouse operations. 

What We’re Looking For 
Friendly, reliable, and great with people. Customer service or admin experience preferred. Strong computer skills and attention to detail. A current driver’s licence is required. 

Why You’ll Love It 
• Training and development opportunities. 
• Chance to grow into a leadership role. 

Apply Now 
Recruit Masters values diversity. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce fosters innovation and creativity, contributing to a positive and dynamic working environment.

All qualified candidates are welcome to apply, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout our recruitment process.
*Please note only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

title: LF/LO Operator
summary:
Warehouse Operator – Eagle Farm - Immediate START

We are currently seeking a Warehouse Operator with a valid LO/LF Licence (High Reach/Order Picker) to join our team in Eagle Farm. Working through XMAS, Public Holidays off, $35 p/h + overtime available. Mon-Fri. 5am-1pm. 

Key Responsibilities:
Operate a Order Picker/High Reach safely and efficiently
Load, unload, scan, and assess materials and parcels
Accurately input data and complete basic reporting
Identify and communicate any errors or issues
Follow security protocols, including daily sign-in procedures
Maintain a clean and safe work environment
What We're Looking For:
Valid LO/LF Licence
Strong attention to detail and communication skills
Physically fit and able to lift parcels as required
Willingness to learn and take on new tasks
Ability to work with technology and input data accurately
Own reliable transport – must be able to travel to Eagle Farm early hours
PPE required: steel cap boots and hi-vis top
If you’re motivated, adaptable, and looking for hands-on work in a fast-paced environment, apply now and join our growing team!

title: Pick Packer

Chance to develop valuable skills in a dynamic, team-oriented environment
